_clock: Time specifications are in days: t=0 is the tumor seed, simulated growth time before surgery is resection.time, total iimulation time is resection.time + solver.time_after_resection.
_schedule: seed (day 0) --> resection (day 100) --> recovery (days 100-114) --> radiotherapy: 30 fractions on consecutive weekdays over 6 weeks (days 114-153, Monday = day 114); concomitant TMZ 75 mg/m^2 daily INCLUDING weekends over the same 6 weeks (days 114-155, 42 sessions) --> 4-week break --> adjuvant TMZ on days 1-5 of six 28-day cycles starting 4 weeks after the last fraction (day 181): days 181-185, 209-213, 237-241, 265-269, 293-297, 321-325; 150 mg/m^2 in cycle 1, 200 mg/m^2 in cycles 2-6 (72 sessions in total) --> growth to day 360 (35 days after the last dose).
_paths: NIfTI paths are absolute or relative to this file. The 'tissue' and 'solver' sections are optional; explicit CLI arguments of scripts/run_stupp_forward.py override them.

solver._units: rho in 1/day, white_matter_diffusivity in mm^2/day, times in days; the horizon is time_after_resection (days after the resection); the time step is set by exactly one of steps_per_day, dt (days) or n_steps. Any other scalar StuppFKPPSolver parameter may be set here under its solver name (e.g. gaussian_seed_mass, min_tissue_fraction, stopping_threshold).

chemotherapy._units: times in days; doses in mg/m^2 (each session deposits a concentration equal to its dose); kill_rate in 1/day per mg/m^2 (PLACEHOLDER: the previous unit-concentration value 0.47 / 75 mg/m^2, so a 75 mg/m^2 session kills as before); decay_rate in 1/day (> 0).

radiotherapy._units: dose NIfTI in Gy, TOTAL over all fractions (per-fraction dose = dose / len(times)); alpha in 1/Gy, beta in 1/Gy^2.
